anatomy.purpose: allowed organs, slots, dependencies and expression topology

authority.purpose: ceilings, delegation, grants, SoD, approvals and kill/freeze controls

cognition.purpose: brain capability requirements, routing classes, councils and deterministic alternatives

communication.purpose: WIR, ports, protocols, channels, membranes and data exchange contracts

constitution.purpose: universal and local laws that cannot be weakened downstream

development.purpose: phenotype maturation law, gap selection, one-gap pulse and expression promotion

evolution.purpose: mutation candidates, replay, shadow, fitness, approval and genome promotion

genesis.purpose: birth, differentiation, reassignment, fusion, retirement and offspring policy

identity.purpose: immutable entity identity, names, lifecycle identity state, tombstone behavior

lineage.purpose: append-only ancestry DAG, successor/fusion relations, retirement and tombstones

memory.purpose: memory classes, scopes, retention, projections and external canonical references

metabolism.purpose: hard ceilings, leased grants, budgets, cost policies and resource accounting

reconstruction.purpose: checkpoint, replay, restore, recovery and clean-host reconstruction requirements

repair.purpose: health, diagnosis, quarantine, retry, fallback, repair and rollback constraints

role.purpose: responsibility paths, role categories, bindings and accountability

skills.purpose: skill bindings to World Skill Registry; maturity and execution contracts

temporal.purpose: pulse classes, cadence, freshness, temporal authority and schedules

topology.purpose: legal/expected relationship patterns; runtime registry remains source of actual edges

invariants.statement: entity identity is unique and is not Brain, Channel, Session, Workflow, or Provider
authority is never minted from nothing; delegated authority is downstream-only and child authority is a subset of parent authority
workers cannot write their own genome in place
fail closed when authority, integrity, identity, or contract validity is uncertain
do not interrupt Life without a governed safety, integrity, or explicit Human Root reason
Human Root is the sole irreversible root authority; ordinary GenomeOps cannot replace or delegate it
Role exists before dedicated Entity birth
retired entity identifiers are permanently tombstoned and never reused
pulse and tempo cannot bypass authority or constitutional gates
evidence precedes mutation promotion and canonical change
compiled genome output is deterministic for identical immutable source layers and compiler/schema versions
Brain hosts may propose events but cannot directly commit canonical events

schema_major_migration.forbidden_if: any LOCKED invariant becomes unrepresentable or unenforceable
schema_major_migration.meaning: structural change to the envelope or data representation without changing LOCKED invariant meaning

constitutional_fork.meaning: change to text or semantics of any LOCKED invariant

rules.EXTEND_ONLY: lower layers may add values only inside an explicit whitelist/registry contract
rules.NARROW_ONLY: lower layers may only reduce scope, ceilings, authority, effects, or allowed sets
rules.OVERRIDABLE: lower layers may replace values only inside upstream constraints

base_sequence: select at most one highest-value real gap at G0 base pulse
prefer deterministic code or existing skill
before new capacity evaluate absorb -> delegate -> shared service -> role birth -> entity birth

offspring_policy_contract.authority_rule: authority(child) subset_of effective delegated authority(parent binding)

resource_model.circuit_breaker: freeze node and require governed review on hard-ceiling violation

resource_grants.retirement_rule: unused revocable allocation returns to issuer/parent according to policy

authority_model.role_binding: holds role-specific delegated grant and scope

skill_model.registry_admission: compiled_or_matured_procedure_only; ephemeral prompts are not registry skills

modes.ABSORB: A survives; B tombstones with merged_into=A; governed memory merge
modes.SYNTHESIZE: C is new entity; A and B tombstone with merged_into=C; C lineage.merged_from=[A,B]
